name: Covered Ovoid Jar (So-Called Ginger Jar) with Decoration of Plum Blossoms against a “Shattered Ice” Ground
summary: Porcelain ovoid jar with cylindrical cover, both decorated with a mottled blue background covered with a geometric “shattered ice” pattern in darker shades of blue. Groups of plum blossoms are composed of negative white spaces with blue outlines indicating petals and stamens. At the shoulder is a border composed of alternating swatches of parallel lines.
